metadata.changelog:
Initial release: ports the NeoForge 1.21.1 data attachment system to Forge 1.20.1.

- Full attachment API: registration, lookup, syncing and serialization
- Attachment lifecycle events and client-side synchronization
- Ported 1.21.1 ByteBufCodecs with common codecs exposed in the api package

---

首次发布：把 NeoForge 1.21.1 的数据附件（Data Attachment）系统移植到 Forge 1.20.1。

- 完整的附件 API：注册、查询、同步与序列化
- 附件生命周期事件与客户端同步
- 移植 1.21.1 的 ByteBufCodecs，在 api 包暴露常用类型编解码器
